simple.meaning: עֲנָה (ʻĂnâh) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Genesis 36:2. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲנָה (H6034) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲנָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עֲנָה (ʻĂnâh) / H6034 is tracked through Genesis 36:2, Genesis 36:14, Genesis 36:18, Genesis 36:20. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
